changes.title: Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. Issues Voluntary Nationwide Consumer-Level Recall of One Lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, Due to Potential Metal Contamination
changes.summary: November 16, 2026— Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. (Breckenridge) is voluntarily recalling to the consumer level one lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, manufactured by Adare Pharma Solutions, due to potential metal contamination.

assessment.english_title: Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. Issues Voluntary Nationwide Consumer-Level Recall of One Lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, Due to Potential Metal Contamination

changes.title: Greenwich Rx Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Compounded Sterile Products Due to Lack of Sterility Assurance
changes.summary: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE - Tomball, Texas – November 20, 2026 – Greenwich Rx, a 503A compounding pharmacy, is voluntarily recalling specific lots of compounded sterile products that remain within their beyond-use dates to the consumer level, including some products that were compounded by Greenwich Rx

assessment.english_title: Greenwich Rx Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Compounded Sterile Products Due to Lack of Sterility Assurance
